description: Your altered flesh slows you throughout the transformation. The Count shelters his own, but only while the pact holds. Your strength will never equal his.

name.str: Bound protection: Servant of the Count

description: Your master and their marked servants leave you alone while you keep the pact. This protects you alone; it does not command demons or make them loyal to your companions.

name.str: Lesser senses: Servant of the Count

description: Your altered flesh slows you throughout the transformation. The Count shelters his own, but only while the pact holds. Your strength will never equal his.
Your permanent pliant body grants +1 strength and 2 points of natural protection, with another -5 speed. Returning to human shape is impossible.

name.str: Borrowed impulse: Servant of the Count

description: Your limited fighting impulse requires recent service to your living master. The body and its weaknesses remain if the bond breaks, but this impulse falls silent.
The limited servant’s body is complete. Neither more flesh nor the master’s death will turn it into an independent apostle. Your choices remain your own, but the pact has a lasting price.
